196.seedSentence: have you heard the latest idea? = avez-vous entendu la dernière idée? -> as-tu entendu la dernière idée?
196.tuTwin: established as-tu + past-participle pattern course-wide (seeds 75, 366, 559, 569, 572); 267's own 'tu as eu' twin verified NOT applicable (different idiom, see notes)
notes: 267 verdict: NOT a mis-gloss. 'have you heard from' = 'tu as eu des nouvelles de' is the idiom avoir des nouvelles de (to have news of), a legitimate partial-component gloss combining with C02 'from'='des nouvelles de'. It is a different construction from 196's literal entendre (to hear [an idea]), so 196 is converted using the established as-tu+participle pattern (as-tu entendu), not by copying 267's text.
S0196L03U03 'do you have an idea?'='avez-vous une idée?' is a separate, non-colliding lego (L03, different known text) — left untouched, out of ruling scope.
